description: Real multi-recipient IMAP flow: Alice request reaches model, Bob replies with his own genuine sender identity and visible Alice/Carol audience on the same References root, but Bob run_pipeline fails unauthorized before his first model request. Put capture/grant/source fixes in PR A #835 and propagate base; put admission/execution-binding fixes in PR B. Ownership/root cause not yet proven; this is not authorization to patch both PRs. Reuse/extend existing owners only. Preserve recipient-local histories/canonical UUIDs, no hidden-recipient inference, immutable roots, actual provider delivery and non-destructive legacy behavior. Complete concurrent/private-recipient assertions after the admission blocker is resolved.
